content: {"episode_id":"ep-05008","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), acknowledging that required prior authorization was missing. The patient has recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia, occurring in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture the arrhythmic burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm changes to guide further management."}
